stack.tailwind: not measured (no direct tailwindcss line found; app uses hand-rolled scoped CSS with --atlas-* custom properties, not Tailwind utility classes, in every component read)
stack.notes: Repo also contains a Python farm-report pipeline at the root (build_farm_report.py, sms_back_parser.py); the Nuxt app is entirely under farm-boundary-map/. No @narduk-enterprises/* dependency at all; vendors @narduk-geo/narduk-mapkit and @narduk-geo/narduk-mapkit-nuxt as local file: tarballs (a different npm scope/package family from narduk-mapkit-nuxt in narduk-libs).

local_reimplementations.name: PortfolioKpiBand
local_reimplementations.notes: Textbook 4-column KPI band (label / big number / unit), responsive to 2-col then padding shrink. Exact-shape match for a shared kpi_stat_tile primitive; NsReadoutTile is the closest existing narduk-ui instrument but is freshness-specific, not generic.

local_reimplementations.name: FarmStatusFilters
local_reimplementations.notes: v-model segmented status-chip filter bar with per-chip counts, aria-pressed, and a mobile horizontal-scroll fallback (scrollbar-width:none + mask-image fade). Textbook filter_search_bar control; narduk-libs ships nothing like it.

local_reimplementations.name: PortfolioFarmGrid
local_reimplementations.notes: Card-list-as-table: one tile per farm entity carrying name, status badge (confirmed/provisional/unresolved/placeholder), acres, field/dataset/observation counts, crop chip list, click-through. Functions as the farm 'table' — see patterns.table.

local_reimplementations.name: PortfolioAttentionList
local_reimplementations.notes: Scrollable detail-list with icon+severity styling per row, truncation notice ('Showing X of Y bounded attention items'), and a hand-rolled empty state ('No factual attention items were identified...'). Good detail_list + empty_state + truncated-pagination-notice example.

local_reimplementations.name: OpsAppBar
local_reimplementations.notes: Custom app bar/header, not narduk-core's LayerAppHeader (app has zero narduk-core dependency).

filter_search_bar.notes: Status-chip filter with counts; server-side search also exists (server/api/farms.get.ts 'q' param) though no local .vue was found calling it directly with a text input in the files read.

status_chip_badge.notes: Status chip used as a filter control, not just display.

empty_state.notes: 'No factual attention items were identified in the current source backup.'

section_header.notes: eyebrow + h2 + count header pattern, repeated in PortfolioAttentionList too.

chart_wrapper.notes: Only 'table'-keyword hit in the app was in this file's context; hand-rolled chart, not a NardukLineChart wrapper (app has zero narduk-charts dependency).

server_list_contracts.notes: Server-side search: trims+lowercases+slices q to 160 chars, plus status-include boolean flags. No pagination — returns the full filtered set.

defect_history.summary: feat: redesign Farm Atlas as Ops Atlas

top_extraction_candidates.name: PortfolioKpiBand
top_extraction_candidates.why: Cleanest, smallest, most literal match anywhere in this lane for a generic KPI-band primitive (label/value/unit, responsive column collapse).

top_extraction_candidates.name: FarmStatusFilters
top_extraction_candidates.why: Complete, accessible (aria-pressed, role=group) segmented status filter with counts and a mobile scroll fallback — ready to generalize.

top_extraction_candidates.name: PortfolioFarmGrid as CollectionTable precedent
top_extraction_candidates.why: Shows exactly what a card-mode row needs (status badge, numeric stat, chip list, click-through) for the shared table's mobile card view.

notes: Small (23-file), design-forward dashboard app with zero narduk-libs adoption but strikingly clean, already-generic-shaped UI (component names literally say KpiBand, StatusFilters, AttentionList). No literal <table>; the one 'table' is a card grid. Every component here has exactly 1 consumer (single-page portfolio dashboard) so consumer counts are uniformly low despite the patterns being reusable across a future estate.
